title: Burning Out
tagline: Four of you. One maze. One torch.
cardBlurb: Get in, find the way out, get everyone back. One torch between the four of you, proximity chat so you can hear each other, and a maze that would rather you didn't.
heroPitch: You and up to three friends get dropped into a dark maze with fire and not much else. Light the way, keep talking, keep moving. It is a very loud game to be in a call for.
body:
## Your light is the clock

Every second you spend exploring is a second of torch you don't get back, which turns every fork in the maze into a group decision made at speed. Splitting up is the fastest way through and the funniest way to lose.

## Proximity chat does the work

Voices fall off with distance, so covering ground and staying together pull against each other the whole time. We barely had to script a scare.

## Made to be played loudly

Four-player online co-op built in Unity on Mirror, tuned for a group call and a lot of shouting. Our first game on Steam, and still the one people put on when friends are over.
